item.title: Cloudstack integration with AzureAD
item.description:
1. Navigate to Azure portal > Services > Azure Entra ID

  1. Click on Enterprise Applications > Create a New Application


  1. Click on Create your own Application and provide a name.
    Select Integrate any other application you don’t find in the gallery (Non-gallery) > Create


  1. Once in the Application, click on Set up Single Sign-on and choose SAML


  1. Make sure SSL is enabled on the Cloudstack management server.
    Login to Cloudstack UI > Global settings > Access > Saml and set the following:
saml2.enabled=true
saml2.redirect.url=http://<mgmtip>:8080/client
saml2.sp.slo.url=http://<mgmtip>:8080/client
saml2.sp.sso.url=http://<mgmtip>:8080/client/api?command=samlSso
  1. Restart the Cloudstack Management service and execute the API to get the SP Metadata for Cloudstack

    https://cloudstack.apache.org/api/apidocs-4.19/apis/getSPMetadata.html
> curl
> [http://\<mgmt\>:8080/client/api?command=getSpMetadata](http://10.0.32.234:8080/client/api?command=getSpMetadata) \>
> metadata.xml
  1. Upload the generated metadata XML into Azure Entra

item.description:
